static.solution:
(i)
Thus,
Cross sections with x fixed give a line in a plane parallel to the yz-plane
Cross sections with y fixed give a line in a plane parallel to the xz-plane
Cross sections with z fixed give a line in a plane parallel to the xy-plane
(ii)
Thus,
Cross sections with x fixed give a horizontal line in a plane parallel to the yz-plane
Cross sections with y fixed give a horizontal line in a plane parallel to the xz-plane
Cross sections with z fixed give an empty set, or a plane parallel to the xy-plane
